acts.6.p1.b1.text: In those days when the disciples were increasing in number, the Grecian Jews among them began to grumble against the Hebraic Jews …

acts.6.p1.b2.text: … because their widows were being overlooked in the daily distribution of food.

acts.6.p1.b3.text: So the Twelve summoned all the disciples and said, …

acts.6.p1.b4.text: “It is unacceptable for us to neglect the word of God in order to wait on tables.

acts.6.p2.b1.text: Therefore, brothers, select from among you seven men confirmed to be full of the Spirit and wisdom. We will appoint this responsibility to them

acts.6.p2.b2.text: and will devote ourselves to prayer and to the ministry of the word.”

acts.6.p2.b3.text: This proposal pleased the whole group. They chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit, …

acts.6.p2.b4.text: … as well as Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolas from Antioch, a convert to Judaism.

acts.6.p3.b1.text: They presented these seven to the apostles, who prayed and laid their hands on them.

acts.6.p3.b2.text: So the word of God continued to spread. The number of disciples in Jerusalem grew rapidly, …

acts.6.p3.b3.text: … and a great number of priests became obedient to the faith.

acts.6.p4.b1.text: Now Stephen, who was full of grace and power, was performing great wonders and signs among the people.

acts.6.p4.b2.text: But resistance arose from what was called the Synagogue of the Freedmen, … They began to argue with Stephen,

acts.6.p4.b3.text: but they could not stand up to his wisdom or the Spirit by whom he spoke.

acts.6.p5.b1.text: Then they prompted some men to say, …

acts.6.p5.b2.text: “We heard Stephen speak words of blasphemy against Moses and against God.”

acts.6.p5.b3.text: So they stirred up the people, elders, and scribes and confronted Stephen. They seized him and brought him before the Sanhedrin,

acts.6.p5.b4.text: “This man never stops speaking against this holy place and against the law.

acts.6.p6.b1.text: For we have heard him say that Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place and change the customs that Moses handed down to us.”

acts.6.p6.b2.text: All who were sitting in the Sanhedrin looked intently at Stephen, …

acts.6.p6.b3.text: … and they saw that his face was like the face of an angel.
